summary: Homepage hero re-centers on every streamed token — answer shifts the view while reading
description: The headingless AskView is embedded in landing.tsx's hero <section> (minHeight 88vh, display:flex, column, alignItems/justifyContent:center) inside a maxWidth:560 centered column. As the guest answer streams, setAnswer(full) grows the block on every token; justifyContent:center re-centers the whole hero (GURU wordmark, tagline, composer, question echo) upward on each token, so the text the user is reading visibly shifts. Fix: top-anchor the hero once a question is submitted (justifyContent switches center→flex-start) so the answer grows downward without moving the content above it. Signal: AskView fires a new onActive callback at submit; landing tracks an 'asking' state. Source-level regression guard (project has no jsdom; static-render + source guards per ask-view.test.tsx / landing-cta.test.ts).

resolution.test_function: the hero centers only until asking, then top-anchors (no re-center on stream)
resolution.note: AskView.onActive fires at submit; landing top-anchors the hero once asking so streaming no longer re-centers the column. Source-level guard (no jsdom in project).
